codes.INV_AMOUNT_INVALID: An amount, quantity or rate on the invoice cannot be used. Check the highlighted fields.
codes.INV_TAX_RATE_INVALID: One of the tax rates cannot be used today: it is inactive or outside its dates. Pick another rate.
codes.INV_NOT_DRAFT: This invoice has been issued, so it can no longer be edited. Duplicate it to start a corrected one.
codes.INV_ORDER_LINKED: This invoice belongs to a sales order, so that order has to be changed instead.
codes.SALESDOC_INVALID_TRANSITION: The proposal or estimate has not been accepted yet, so it cannot become an invoice.
codes.SALESDOC_ALREADY_CONVERTED: This document was already turned into an invoice.

builder.buyerCountryHint: Two letters, like IN or GB. Decides the tax id format and, in automatic mode, the tax.
builder.taxIdHint: GSTIN, VAT number, EIN... Checked as you type.

builder.referenceHint: The buyer's purchase order number or any reference to print.

taxModeHint.rates: Pick a tax rate for each line. A line left on the default uses your workspace's default rate.
taxModeHint.auto: The tax engine decides each line's tax from your country, the buyer's country and tax id, the supply and the place of supply. The server's answer is what is saved.

builder.sellerCountryMissing: Automatic tax needs your country in the invoicing profile (a country with a tax preset). Set it there first.
builder.placeOfSupplyHint: A state or province of {country}; leave on the first choice for the whole country.
builder.reverseChargeHint: The buyer accounts for the tax, so none is charged on this invoice.
builder.legalNotesHint: Wording required on the document, such as a reverse-charge statement. Automatic mode fills it in when the law asks for it.

problems.contactRequired: Pick a contact or type the buyer's name.
problems.dueBeforeIssue: The due date cannot be before the issue date.
problems.noLines: Add at least one line before issuing.
problems.discountInvalid: Enter a valid discount (a percentage from 0 to 100, or an amount).
problems.amountZero: The invoice total must be more than zero.
problems.amountInvalid: An amount is too large or has too many decimals for this currency.
problems.regionInvalid: Use a short region code, up to three letters or digits.
problems.autoNeedsSellerCountry: Set your country in the invoicing profile to use automatic tax.
problems.qtyInvalid: Enter a quantity above zero, with at most 4 decimals.
problems.priceInvalid: Enter a valid price with the decimals this currency allows.
problems.hsnRequired: Enter the HSN/SAC code. Your country asks for it on each line.
problems.hsnInvalid: An HSN/SAC code is 2 to 12 letters or digits.
problems.taxRateRemoved: The tax rate of this line was removed. Pick a current one.
